## Summary

I ran SEOAgent's full audit workflow against the live site (`http://127.0.0.1:43051`) and found this is a **pivot in progress**: the product has rebranded from **InboxZap** (email-inbox cleanup) to **Lumina** (AI meeting assistant), but the migration wasn't finished — both in code and in Google Search Console history.

### Fixed directly in this repo
- **`app/layout.tsx`** — page metadata still said "InboxZap — Clean Your Inbox in Minutes" while the live `<head>` already correctly serves Lumina branding. Repo was stale; now matches.
- **`app/blog/page.tsx`** — was a client-only component fetching `/api/posts`, which I confirmed **404s live** — real visitors likely saw "Could not load posts." It's now a server component rendering a real post list from a new `app/blog/posts.ts` module (no broken dependency, content visible to crawlers).
- **`app/sitemap.ts`** — listed 0 of the 12 live blog posts. Now includes all of them, sourced from the same `posts.ts` so it can't drift from the index.
- **`app/page.tsx`** — added a real `#faq` section, since nav links to `/faq` and `next.config.js` already redirects there, but that target didn't exist.

### Confirmed live but **not fixable here** — no source for these routes exists in this repo
- `/pricing`: missing canonical tag, no JSON-LD
- `/features`: two conflicting `<h1>`s ("Features" and "Integrations")
- All 12 blog posts: no meta description, no `BlogPosting` schema
- 3 homepage images missing `alt` text (the live homepage renders markup — a hero image, two step icons — that isn't in this repo's `app/page.tsx` either)
- `/blog/post-3` and `/blog/post-7` cannibalize each other (near-identical "bulk delete emails" content)

### Migration plan (mandatory given GSC data + positioning mismatch)
Full table in `.seoagent/strategy/migration-plan.md`: **1 harvest** (keep the homepage, it's already on-strategy — I corrected the tool's own misclassification here) **· 12 redirect** (every legacy InboxZap blog post — real impressions worth preserving, proposed to 301 into `/blog` until Lumina content exists to redirect into instead).

### Not touched (already correct — avoided false "fixes")
robots.txt, homepage canonical/OG/Organization+SoftwareApplication schema, and the other pages' existing OG/Twitter tags were all already correct and left alone.

### Next steps
A forward content plan (`ai-meeting-assistant` cluster, pillar + subs + long-tails) is in `.seoagent/roadmap.md`, ready to brief and write in a follow-up session — intentionally not drafted now per session scope. The highest-leverage remaining work is getting canonical/schema/alt fixes applied wherever `/pricing`, `/features`, and the blog post template actually live (outside this repo), and deciding the actual 301 targets as Lumina content ships.
